title: GTA 6 Characters Explained: Who's Who in Leonida (No Spoilers)
title_alternatives: Every GTA 6 Character You Need to Know (Spoiler-Free)
GTA 6 Story Explained: Jason, Lucia and Everyone Around Them
description_summary: A spoiler-free guide to the GTA 6 cast: Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, plus Cal Hampton, Brian Heder, Boobie Ike, Dre'Quan Priest, Real Dimez, Raul Bautista and more. Who they are, how they connect, and the easter eggs hidden in their backstories.

beats.caption: GTA 6 has the biggest cast Rockstar has ever built around a single story. So before you get lost in Leonida, here's who's who: the two leads, the people pulling their strings, and the details hidden in their backstories. And don't worry, this video is spoiler-free.
beats.tts: GTA 6 has the biggest cast Rockstar has ever built around a single story. So before you get lost in Leonida, here's who's who: the two leads, the people pulling their strings, and the details hidden in their backstories. And don't worry, this video is spoiler-free.

beats.caption: Everything here comes from Rockstar's official character material and the setup you see in the first hours. No story twists, no endings. Just who these people are and why they matter.

beats.caption: Let's start with Lucia Caminos. She's one of the two playable leads, and the first Latina protagonist in the history of GTA.
beats.tts: Let's start with Lucia Caminos. She's one of the two playable leads, and the first Latina protagonist in the history of GTA.

beats.caption: Lucia's father trained her to fight from a young age. She ended up in Leonida Penitentiary after getting into trouble while defending her family, and she got out through a stroke of luck.
beats.tts: Lucia's father trained her to fight from a young age. She ended up in Leonida Penitentiary after getting into trouble while defending her family, and she got out through a stroke of luck.

beats.caption: Now she's determined to turn her life around, and she's willing to bend the rules to take control of her future. Jason could be her route to a better life, or the thing that ruins it.
beats.tts: Now she's determined to turn her life around, and she's willing to bend the rules to take control of her future. Jason could be her route to a better life, or the thing that ruins it.

beats.caption: There's even a link to older games. Lucia's official Rockstar profile says her mother wanted a good life for her ever since their days in Liberty City, the setting of GTA 3 and GTA 4.
beats.tts: There's even a link to older games. Lucia's official Rockstar profile says her mother wanted a good life for her ever since their days in Liberty City, the setting of GTA 3 and GTA 4.

beats.caption: Leonida Penitentiary isn't just backstory, by the way. It's a real location on the map, so you can visit the place that shaped her.

beats.caption: The other lead is Jason Duval. He grew up around con artists and criminals, and he joined the US Army looking for a fresh start. He didn't find one.
beats.tts: The other lead is Jason Duval. He grew up around con artists and criminals, and he joined the US Army looking for a fresh start. He didn't find one.

beats.caption: After the army, he ended up working for drug smugglers in the Leonida Keys. What he really wants is a quiet life. And the story keeps asking whether Lucia is the best or the worst thing that ever happened to him.
beats.tts: After the army, he ended up working for drug smugglers in the Leonida Keys. What he really wants is a quiet life. And the story keeps asking whether Lucia is the best or the worst thing that ever happened to him.

beats.caption: You'll get to know Jason's world fast. He lives in the Keys, there are old photos hidden under the floorboards in his bedroom that fill in his backstory, and he even has a pet snake named Dolores.
beats.tts: You'll get to know Jason's world fast. He lives in the Keys, there are old photos hidden under the floorboards in his bedroom that fill in his backstory, and he even has a pet snake named Dolores.

beats.caption: Jason's personal car at the start is a Vapid Ganado 70, a classic Ranchero-style pickup. It's not fast, but it says a lot about who he is: practical, a bit worn, and not trying to impress anyone.

beats.caption: Together, Jason and Lucia are a Bonnie and Clyde-style duo. That's the heart of GTA 6: two people who might be good for each other, in a place that's terrible for both of them.

beats.caption: Now the supporting cast, starting with Cal Hampton, Jason's friend. Rockstar's own line about him is: Cal is at the low tide of America and happy there.

beats.caption: Cal prefers staying home, drinking beer and browsing the internet while listening in on Coast Guard communications. He believes the world is run by psychopaths and sees conspiracies everywhere. Jason has bigger plans, and Cal isn't sure he wants in.

beats.caption: Then there's Brian Heder, a retired smuggler who still runs illegal operations from a marina and uses younger associates, like Jason, for the dangerous work.

beats.caption: Brian worked the Florida coast during smuggling's most profitable era. His third wife, Lori, helps run the business. He looks laid-back, but Rockstar compares his business methods to a shark's.

beats.caption: His drug money financed property, a recording studio, and the Jack of Hearts strip club. And he co-runs the record label Only Raw Records with our next character.

beats.caption: Dre'Quan Priest. He sold drugs to get by, but he always wanted a career in music. Now he runs Only Raw Records with Boobie and hunts for new talent.

beats.caption: He organises performances at the Jack of Hearts, and he even uses the club's dancers as a test audience for new tracks. His own songs never took off, but he has a real talent for spotting talent.

beats.caption: That talent is Real Dimez, the rap duo of Bae-Luxe and Roxy. They've been friends since secondary school.

beats.caption: Before music, they extorted local drug dealers, and they used that experience in their tracks and their social media content. Their breakthrough single featured local rapper DWNPLY, and after five years of effort they signed to Only Raw.

beats.caption: And then there's Raul Bautista, a seasoned bank robber who recruits accomplices for big jobs. He's charming, cunning and drawn to high-risk work, and he turns down anything small-time.

beats.caption: A couple more names to know. Andrés de León is a high-profile VIP that Jason and Lucia get hired to protect. Rockstar hasn't shared much about him yet.

beats.caption: Beyond the main cast, you'll meet a set of contacts who matter for gameplay. In the Keys there's Kenton, who runs a scuba boat shop with a side business in underwater treasure diving.

beats.caption: One gameplay detail that connects to the characters: Jason and Lucia each have their own criminal profile, and the one you're not controlling behaves according to theirs.
